schema.content:
Table "employee" {
  "employee_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "first_name" TEXT
  "last_name" TEXT
  "address" TEXT
  "city" TEXT
  "state" TEXT
  "zip" INTEGER
  "phone" TEXT
  "title" TEXT
  "salary" INTEGER
  "supervisor" INTEGER
}

Table "establishment" {
  "license_no" INTEGER [pk]
  "dba_name" TEXT
  "aka_name" TEXT
  "facility_type" TEXT
  "risk_level" INTEGER
  "address" TEXT
  "city" TEXT
  "state" TEXT
  "zip" INTEGER
  "latitude" REAL
  "longitude" REAL
  "ward" INTEGER
}

Table "inspection" {
  "inspection_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "inspection_date" DATE
  "inspection_type" TEXT
  "results" TEXT
  "employee_id" INTEGER
  "license_no" INTEGER
  "followup_to" INTEGER
}

Table "inspection_point" {
  "point_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "Description" TEXT
  "category" TEXT
  "code" TEXT
  "fine" INTEGER
  "point_level" TEXT
}

Table "violation" {
  "inspection_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "point_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "fine" INTEGER
  "inspector_comment" TEXT
}



Ref: "employee"."supervisor" > "employee"."employee_id"

Ref: "inspection"."followup_to" > "inspection"."inspection_id"

Ref: "inspection"."license_no" > "establishment"."license_no"

Ref: "inspection"."employee_id" > "employee"."employee_id"

Ref: "violation"."point_id" > "inspection_point"."point_id"

Ref: "violation"."inspection_id" > "inspection"."inspection_id"
